name: Eladi & Coconut Milk Soap

Improves skin tone and natural complexion

name: Kesar Neem Face Wash
description: A gentle, soap-free facial cleanser combining the purifying qualities of organic neem with the brightening benefits of Kashmiri saffron (Kesar) for acne-free, glowing skin.
benefits: Deeply cleanses pores and controls excess oil
Combats acne-causing bacteria and prevents breakouts
Brightens dark spots and skin pigmentation

benefits: Locks in moisture for long-lasting hydration
Softens, smooths, and repairs dry, cracked lips
Protects lips from cold winds and sun damage

name: Rakta Chandan Bathing Soap

benefits: Fades blemishes, acne scars, and sun tans
Provides a cooling sensation and reduces inflammation
Gently exfoliates dead skin cells for smooth texture
Suitable for all skin types, especially sensitive skin
